verdict.rationale: Mem0's self-hosted server documents per-user API keys, an admin account, and a request/live audit log, which covers auditing access and basic per-user credentialing. There is no documented role, policy, or ACL model that governs who or what can read or write specific memories. Entity scoping by user, agent, app, and session partitions data but is not an access-control mechanism, and the audit log is evidenced only for the self-hosted bundle. Missing for 10: documented roles/RBAC, policy or ACL controls over read/write permissions, audit and access governance on the hosted Platform, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can govern who and what can read or write memory with roles, policies, or access-control lists, and audit that access
